1 · what the curve showedAudience rises and holds through the Needles Eye tunnel walkway (*+1.9% of viewers present, 304 regained, held 6 samples*). 2 · evidence at that second“if i make it to the other side i survived” (transcript) 3 · why (the check or the quote)Viewers rewind a risk beat with a stated stake: "if i make it to the other side i survived". 4 · how (the next move)Front-load a two-second flash of the walkway climb in the first 60 seconds alongside the Rushmore tease. 5 · rationaleStated real stakes hold audiences; showing the moment early plants a second known destination without spoiling the outcome.

I am so SICK of this!

published 2022-07-11 · analysed 2026-08-19

1 · Retention breakdown

curve100 samples, stored one per percent runtime31:38 gone by 0:3022% at halfway18% still watching methodhazard = (present before − present after) ÷ present before at each moment; baseline = mean hazard of the previous 5 moments, floored; flagged when the excess viewers lost beyond baseline ranks high; a rise is a rewind only when no comparable drop precedes it and the lift survives the next sample

Red marks are flagged drops, green are earned rewinds. Hover a mark for its note.

2 · Each flagged moment: from curve to note

drop0:19
1 · what the curve showedViewers bail through the sick-week explainer (*13.1x surrounding stop rate, 10,779 viewers gone, 33rd percentile vs similar videos*). 2 · evidence at that second“i've been really sick” (transcript) 3 · why (the check or the quote)She opens on a missed-upload apology and health recap — 'i've been really sick... i missed an upload last week' — before any ride content lands. 4 · how (the next move)Cut 0:08-0:47 and open on the 7:07 'oh my god it feels so good to ride' beat, then backfill the flu context in one line. 5 · rationaleThe intro's job is context, stakes, goal in two sentences; opening on a channel-greeting apology contradicts the 'SICK of this' title-promise.
peak6:39
1 · what the curve showedA smaller rebound as the ride finally begins (*audience rises 3.9%, 675 regained, held only 3 samples, 55th percentile*). 2 · evidence at that second“let's hop on the bike” (transcript) 3 · why (the check or the quote)The garage-to-road transition delivers the title's promised ride — 'goodbye my beauties... let's hop on the bike' — after six minutes of setup. 4 · how (the next move)Cut 6:05-6:36 garage plotting and jump from the flu context straight to 'let's hop on the bike' at 7:04. 5 · rationalePositive progression holds and stripping-down phases lose people; the peak shows viewers waited through setup for this beat, so compressing to it protects the next segment. cautionThe garage banter with Jordan may be a recurring character beat viewers expect — if community comments prove that, keep one 4-second exchange instead of cutting the whole block.
drop7:17
1 · what the curve showedA second exit wave hits during the ride-along monologue (*9.0x surrounding stop rate, 2,353 viewers lost, 1.6x the channel norm*). 2 · evidence at that second“i was just out for the count” (transcript) 3 · why (the check or the quote)She loops back to the sickness the intro already covered — 'i was just out for the count completely sick, totally wiped out' — while the ride itself stalls. 4 · how (the next move)Cut 7:13-7:45 and hold on the road/cows footage with the 'a bike ride by' tearing-up beat as a single 8-second moment. 5 · rationaleKill repetition — visual, verbal, narrative; the flu recap is the third mention and the pacing rule wants new information every ~5 seconds.
peak20:53
1 · what the curve showedAudience climbs into the dealership arrival (*rises 8.6%, held for 21 samples, 789 viewers regained, 71st percentile*). 2 · evidence at that second“america's oldest harley dealer” (transcript) 3 · why (the check or the quote)The arrival lands a location change and a named destination — 'pharaoh harley davidson america's oldest harley dealer' — after 20 minutes of road. 4 · how (the next move)Tighten 20:25-20:47 to a 6-second arrival cut and drop a riser under it starting around 20:33 into the 'service department' line. 5 · rationaleStart anticipatory music ~20 seconds before a key moment; the peak shows viewers already scrubbing here, so scoring the approach holds the room into it.
peak21:12
1 · what the curve showedThe Sportster wall pulls viewers back (*audience rises 13.0%, 1,298 regained, 73rd percentile vs similar videos*). 2 · evidence at that second“look at all these damn sportsters” (transcript) 3 · why (the check or the quote)She calls out the inventory reveal — 'look at all these damn sportsters... they have been selling so good this year' — a countable, visual moment worth rewinding. 4 · how (the next move)Front-load a 3-second Sportster-wall flash into the cold open at 0:05 as the out-of-context hook, then pay it off in place at 21:12. 5 · rationaleTease and announce the reward early; the peak proves the wall earns rewinds, so using it as the opener converts the hook the flu apology currently wastes.
drop24:59
1 · what the curve showedViewers leave during the post-service debrief (*8.0x surrounding stop rate, 2.9x the channel norm, 1,086 viewers lost*). 2 · evidence at that second“25 000 mile service” (transcript) 3 · why (the check or the quote)The tension resolves into a checklist recap — '25 000 mile service... checking all the fluids and the seals' — with the Sturgis payoff already stated. 4 · how (the next move)Cut 24:58-25:24 and jump from 'nasty girl / I love it' straight to a Sturgis-prep tease that withholds the trip itself. 5 · rationaleRetention drops the moment tension is spent; the service verdict was already delivered, so the itemised recap releases the room before the outro.

Channel · Ideas and how they were assembled

Published 2026-08-18. Method: a proven SHAPE from the format library is crossed with a SUBJECT that is surging (trend chart, corpus, or the channel's own catalogue); the model writes the title and premise, code computes the projection.

I Put an Android Auto Screen on My Harley Road Glide — Full Review shape: Motorcycle CarPlay Product Review
projection140,970 (100,388–181,552) arithmeticThis channel's median upload does 54K views. The "Motorcycle CarPlay Product Review" format runs 2.61x its channels' medians across 7 observed videos, so the midpoint is 54K x 2.61. The range is this channel's own spread between its quartiles, not a fixed margin. model's reasoningThe CarPlay-dash category is a proven 2.61x lift on peer channel TwoWheelObsession, and this channel already has a review audience from the Insta360 video — but that review died mid-way, so I'm keeping this one ride-anchored on her Road Glide instead of a static bench test. evidence cited5 videos (ids validated against the supplied corpus; fabricated ids are dropped and counted)
I Let a Chinese Motorcycle Mechanic Tear Into My Harley shape: Named Expert Cameo
projection154,473 (110,004–198,942) arithmeticThis channel's median upload does 54K views. The "Named Expert Cameo" format runs 2.86x its channels' medians across 3 observed videos, so the midpoint is 54K x 2.86. The range is this channel's own spread between its quartiles, not a fixed margin. model's reasoningMissenden Flyer's Allen Millyard cameos are the highest-lift shape in the niche (2.86x), and 'Chinese' is currently the hottest bike subject at 2.50x. Her ongoing Road Glide saga (Last Hope, Final Straw) is the perfect project bike to hand over — and a named cameo fixes the 51-second setup bleed that killed the last Harley video. evidence cited5 videos (ids validated against the supplied corpus; fabricated ids are dropped and counted)

The range is this channel's own spread between its quartiles, not a fixed margin. model's reasoningTwoWheelObsession's 'Full Review' shape lifts 1.67x across 16 videos, and 'riders' is a 1.78x hot subject. Framing it around two-up riders is her lane (she already rides with a partner) and gives the review a specific audience the Insta360 video lacked — which is exactly why that one collapsed at 5:00. evidence cited5 videos (ids validated against the supplied corpus; fabricated ids are dropped and counted)

The range is this channel's own spread between its quartiles, not a fixed margin. model's reasoningMoto Camp Nerd's 'Our Kit for X' shape is a 2.17x proven lift and BMW is a 1.52x hot subject with 6 niche hits. This channel already proved camping content lands (I Thought It Was Just a Campout, Sturgis Camping Alone), but the follow-through drops — a flatlay-driven kit video keeps visual momentum through the second-minute cliff. evidence cited6 videos (ids validated against the supplied corpus; fabricated ids are dropped and counted)
